alt: Parietal cell secreting acid. Metabolic CO2 + H2O form carbonic acid; HCO3- leaves across the basolateral membrane in exchange for Cl- (the alkaline tide) while H+ is pumped into the stomach lumen by the apical H+/K+ ATPase - the step blocked by proton-pump inhibitors. Cl- follows through an apical channel and a basolateral Na+/K+ ATPase is also shown.
